Actually insulated wire/cable not fitted with connectors: 8544.49. Other, of copper: 8544.49.60? Historically 8544.49.6040? CBP rulings on data cable: 8544.49.6040? Let me recall: 8544.49.60 "other conductors... of copper" — 10-digit 8544.49.6040? I think 8544.49.6040 exists ("Other"). Use that.
